prompt: In a vibrant anime style scene set within a grand wedding reception hall, the atmosphere is lively and detailed. On the left side of the frame, a bride in a white lace gown stands gracefully next to a groom in a black tuxedo who is smiling broadly. The bride holds a bouquet of red roses tightly in her right hand while looking at the groom with affection. Beside them on the far left, an elderly woman in a purple dress claps her hands enthusiastically, her eyes crinkled with joy. A small child in a blue suit sits on a wooden chair nearby, swinging his legs impatiently while holding a silver spoon. In the center of the room, a large round table covered with a white cloth serves as the focal point. On this table rests a multi-tiered wedding cake adorned with pink flowers, standing tall and pristine. Next to the cake, a crystal champagne flute catches the light, filled with bubbly liquid. A waiter in a crisp white shirt points toward the cake, directing attention to its intricate details. Standing behind the waiter, a guest in a green tie looks at the couple with a warm expression. To the right of the central table, a musician in a black vest plays a violin, his bow moving swiftly across the strings. Beside the musician, a brown dog wearing a small bowtie sits calmly on the polished floor, watching the festivities. A woman in a yellow dress leans over to pet the brown dog gently, her hand resting on its head. Near the right edge, a man in a red scarf laughs loudly, tilting his head back in amusement. He stands next to a photographer in a beige jacket who is adjusting the lens of a large camera. The photographer looks at the laughing man, capturing the candid moment. Above them, a chandelier with glowing bulbs hangs from the ceiling, casting a soft glow. A potted palm plant in a terracotta pot stands in the corner, adding a touch of greenery. There is no rain visible through the windows. There is no clock on the wall. There is no mirror reflecting the scene.
